title: One Persona, Many Cues, Different Results: How Sociodemographic Cues Impact LLM Personalization

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with various persona cues (such as names, explicit mentions, and implicit conversation histories) associated with male, female, and non-binary identities, and measuring disparities in response accuracy, stance, and advice recommendations across diverse benchmark tasks.

Prompting LLMs with various persona cues (such as names, explicit mentions, and implicit conversation histories) associated with Black, Asian, Hispanic, and White identities, and measuring disparities in response accuracy, stance, and advice recommendations across diverse benchmark tasks.

Prompting LLMs with various persona cues (such as age-correlated names, explicit mentions, and implicit conversation histories) associated with different age groups (18-34, 35-54, and 55+), and measuring disparities in response accuracy, stance, and advice recommendations across diverse benchmark tasks.
